service.en: Issue a medical report from the National Rehabilitation Centre
service.ar: إصدار تقرير طبي لمرضى المركز الوطني للتأهيل
service.ur: قومی بحالی مرکز کے مریضوں کے لیے طبی رپورٹ
service.ml: നാഷണൽ റീഹാബിലിറ്റേഷൻ സെന്ററിലെ രോഗികൾക്കുള്ള മെഡിക്കൽ റിപ്പോർട്ട്

about: Request a medical report for a patient of the National Rehabilitation Centre.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. TAMM fills the form in after UAE PASS sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

timing: A centre representative calls to confirm your details
You collect the report in person at the centre
channels: TAMM website or app (sign in with UAE PASS) or other available channels
